About the Portal

This beta version of the Reproductive System Knowledge Portal aggregates and integrates genetic association, functional genomic, and computational results to accelerate research on reproductive traits and conditions.

About the project

The Reproductive System Knowledge Portal is being developed by a team of scientists and software engineers at the Broad Institute of MIT and Harvard and collaborating researchers across the globe, with support from the National Human Genome Research Institute. We welcome the involvement of interested researchers. If you would like to contribute data or collaborate on analyses, methods, or tool development, please contact us.

Getting started

Are you interested in what human genetics can tell you about your favorite gene, but not sure where to start in the Reproductive System Knowledge Portal? We've outlined a workflow that can help you assess the weight of genetic evidence for involvement of a gene in a biological process. See the workflow in a step-by-step guide or in this brief video.
